provider_scale_normalization: E011_ROPELENGTH_EQUIVALENT_D: D_eff_raw = L_raw / Rop_E011; rescale centerline so D_eff=1

eigenvector_tracking.selection_rule: Anchor at finest-N C006 selected positive-frequency root, then track backward by combined eigenvalue distance and complex eigenvector overlap.

rpo_conditioning.parameter_rule: Use exactly the same offset/D, eps/D, channel phase and circulations as the spectral generator; no scan or post-hoc parameter selection.

cross_provider_agreement.provider_weighting: one vote per independent E011 provider anchor; consensus is the median over providers
cross_provider_agreement.threshold_note: Method tolerances frozen before the first v0.2.0 run; not fitted to A044/GRB targets.

policy.legacy_full_spectrum_tracking: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_IN_V0.2; selected branch identity is certified by eigenvector overlap
